findings.title: Refund completion must require a prior refund request (no payout for an un-requested refund)
findings.evidence: Scenario: reset -> GET order -> POST refund/complete directly (no refund/request) -> GET order. Cites observed-UI rule UIR-002 (Complete refund only appears after a refund request exists). The workflow-gating bypass claim is not fully proven by the monetary bound alone, so the workflow aspect is NEEDS_REVIEW; the executable monetary check is sum_lte order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount.
